reference_policy.description: Official HF equations with instance-local FP32 recurrent-cache allocation from the first prefill; official update copy is unchanged. Conv and KV caches retain the model dtype.

logit_mask: No logits are masked: all exact-vocabulary entries must be finite.

metrics_definition.top1_agreement: fraction of evaluated steps with identical argmax token
metrics_definition.step_scope: Seven requests, each one prefill and 31 decode forwards; lengths 1,16,128,512 plus A1/B/A2.

privacy_note: Explicit allowlist export; original files are linked by logical evidence ID and SHA256. Private paths, hostnames, user names, process IDs and device process listings are omitted.
evidence_kind: Historical failures with explicit FP32 recurrent-cache reference; policy change alone did not resolve all deviations.
